description.value:
Duration constant

You are legendary with every firearm regardless of category, familiarity, or condition. Any firearm you hold loses a Failure Range for as long as you hold it, and you may use any feat on this page that names a specific weapon type with any firearm at all, provided the fiction survives the substitution.
